_about: FEEL [haptic feedback], rule 309, ask line 302 (Paolo 11/2, passing on a playtester: 'make sure it gives haptic feedback, that's super important... controllers, or vibrating on their phone'). EVERY BUZZ IN THE GAME, ONE TABLE, read by engine/bohemia_haptics.js (the one call, haptic(kind)); nothing else in the game holds a felt number for the hand. A modder edits this file, or hands a whole table as window.BOH_HAPTICS_TABLE before the game boots. THE RULES IT FOLLOWS (Apple's Human Interface Guidelines, playing haptics: a haptic matches what is seen and heard, used sparingly, never a constant buzz; Android's haptics design principles: less is more, clear and crisp over buzzy, predefined effects so a feel means one thing): short, crisp, sparse, and every kind carries its reason. A sound the 'sounds' map does not name is never felt: footsteps, the music and its beat, the room, doors, the bag. FIELDS OF A KIND: vibrate = Android's navigator.vibrate, milliseconds on, off, on...; native = the app wrapper's haptics (Capacitor: impact LIGHT/MEDIUM/HEAVY, notification SUCCESS/WARNING/ERROR, selection); ios_ticks = how many system ticks the iPhone switch plays (a heavier kind is more ticks, never a longer one); pad = a controller's rumble [milliseconds, strong motor 0..1, weak motor 0..1]; priority = a buzz never starts while one of the same or higher priority is still playing; cooldown_ms = the same kind is not felt again inside this; hold_ms = how long it counts as playing where there is no vibrate pattern. THE SOUNDS MAP: a sound's name to a kind, or {fact: {value: kind, '*': kind}} when the same sound means two things (whose man went down; won or lost). draft: true, every number a first attempt for TUNING's table.

settings._why: default_on: a phone game with no buzz feels dead in the hand, and he asked for it on. light_scale: LIGHT halves every length and every motor. min_on_ms: under about 8 ms many Android motors never spin up, so a scaled pulse never goes below it. min_gap_ms: the breath between two buzzes so they read as two, not one smear. gesture_window_ms: the iPhone switch only plays inside a touch; where the browser cannot say, a touch counts for this long. ios_tick_gap_ms: the gap between the iPhone's ticks, fast enough to read as one event. log_keep: how many calls the probe can read back. light_native: LIGHT drops a native impact one step. light_notification_impact: LIGHT plays a notification as this impact instead.

setting._why: the row on the gear's card, after MOTION. One button that steps through the three, like MOTION's FULL. On by default; saved on the phone.
setting.label: BUZZ

tap.why: a button on the phone answered. The lightest thing in the table, the iPhone's own selection tick; you only notice it when it is missing.

deny.why: you cannot do that. Two small ticks, short and flat, never a buzzer (his own brief for the refusal's sound).

hit.why: a blow of yours lands. It sits on THE PUNCH's freeze (the struck man holds the impact key for 0.1 to 0.24 of a beat, 50 to 120 ms at 120 BPM): the sound and this go out in the same instant, and it is shorter than the shortest freeze, so it is over before he moves again.

hurt.why: one of yours takes a blow. A step heavier than landing one, so the hand can tell giving from taking without looking.

big_hit.why: the vital hit (the head, a blow that takes half of him), or one of theirs struck down: the freeze is at its longest, so is this.

kill.why: a man of theirs dies: the blow, a gap, the body landing. The fight holds a whole beat of frozen world on a kill; this fills the front of it.

struck_down.why: one of HIS men is struck down (the 20 percent die, else the long injury): a warning, two hard pulses with room between, the one buzz in the fight that says look now.

man_lost.why: one of HIS men dies. The error pattern: three, the last one longest. Rare, and it should hurt.

won.why: the fight is won, felt when the recap opens: success, a small tap then a fuller one.

lost.why: the fight is lost, felt when the recap opens: the error pattern, heavier than a man lost.

withdrew.why: he pulled the company out: a warning, not a loss.

paid.why: batteries come in (a job's pay, a sale): success, the same shape as winning but smaller, so getting paid feels like a small win.

level_up.why: a man levels up: the biggest reward that comes back again and again, so three rising pulses, the last one held.

perk.why: a perk comes on: one firm press, the thing he chose clicks into place.

verb.why: a boss hands him a verb, the largest single reward in the game: the level-up shape, longer.

boss_down.why: the boss goes down: a kill, heavier and longer, because a kill cannot carry it.

dial_shot.why: the dial's important shot, on the beat: one heavy press you earn by timing. Ready for the dial: the fight he plays has set the dial aside until he calls it, so nothing there calls it yet; the old COMBAT tab's dial fires its own vibrations, and those come through here as 'raw'.

empty.why: his last round is gone, the slide locks back: one small tick that teaches the reload before the words do.

phone.why: the phone in the game buzzes (a post landed): the real phone buzzes the same way, twice and soft, and never more than once in a while.

raw.why: a frame of ours that still calls navigator.vibrate itself (the old COMBAT tab's dial and kills): its own pattern plays, but through here, so BUZZ OFF turns it off and LIGHT halves it.

sounds._why: the sound's name (engine/bohemia_sfx.js EVENTS, and the fight's own) to the kind. Left out on purpose: every footstep, shot, swing and miss (the landing is the moment, not the trigger), the music, the room, doors, the bag, the save bell, experience (it fires often and has to be nearly nothing).
